## SSANRA self-assessment

Scored by the authors against the six items of SANRA [@baethge2019] (0 = low, 1
= moderate, 2 = high). Provisional, to be repeated after screening and second
coding.

::: {.list-table header-rows=1 aligns="l,c,l" tbl-colwidths="[45,10,45]"}
- - SANRA item
  - Score
  - Justification

- - Justification of the article's importance for the readership
  - 2
  - Burden, service gap and evidence gap stated with sources (Introduction)

- - Statement of concrete aims or questions
  - 2
  - Three research questions stated

- - Description of the literature search
  - 1
  - Databases, queries and dates reported (S4); screening counts not yet complete

- - Referencing
  - 2
  - Key statements referenced; reliance on news flagged in text

- - Scientific reasoning
  - 1
  - Common framework applied to all cases; several cases rest on grey literature

- - Appropriate presentation of data
  - 2
  - Scores tabulated per case and per item with justifications

- - **Total**
  - []{colspan=2 aligns="l"} **10 / 12**
:::
